notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.3.2 - Poll: importing a device whose IP is not an IPv4 address (for example localhost) is now refused with a reason, like the other rules, instead of failing later at Connect. Add device (+) never suggests an IP that OK would refuse; it falls back to 127.0.0.1. When two paths name one serial port, the message shows both, for example RTU /tmp/ttyV0 (= /dev/pts/0). Add device, Edit device and the other dialogs with OK / Cancel now look like the rest of the app: Cancel on the left, the main button on the right, no icons. Linux: opening the window on a computer without a display now says so and suggests --run-script, instead of a misleading message about a missing xcb library.
